answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 480 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the willow log shows the live set and the delta audit records each lapse. Keeping 238 aliases alive therefore means 238 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the vertex quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
